example.title: Dana Point Harbor marina finger dock (view along bulkhead)
example.place: Dana Point Harbor, Dana Point, Orange County, CA

brief: One of the marina's floating finger docks (1971): a narrow concrete-pontoon walk 1.5 m wide running out from the main dock between rows of slips, white-hulled sailboats and motor yachts moored either side, cleats and power pedestals, held by round concrete guide piles. One photo; this record is the dock row seen in the view along the bulkhead (the nearest dock row). Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
